Both correct, according to themselves. So on Queue Ess Mee, the subcontractor puts proof and invoice on the stage, not in an inbox. Only the payer can mark it paid, and the screen's honest about it: this goes on your word, and the remittance? Actually attached. Only the receiver can confirm it, once the money's landed.
